## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I ran the narrowest relevant Pest tests.
- [ ] I ran `composer ci:check`.
- [ ] I ran dependency audits or explained why they do not apply.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-facing, configuration, or deployment changes.

## Operational impact

List migrations, new environment variables, queue or scheduler changes, deployment steps, and compatibility concerns. Write “None” when there is no operational impact.

## Security and privacy

Confirm that the pull request contains no secrets, production data, licensed private packages, or unnecessary personal data. Security fixes must be coordinated through a private GitHub Security Advisory before publication.
